query: UPDATE channels c SET spent_tokens = CASE WHEN c.budget_window_start IS NULL OR c.budget_window_start + make_interval(secs => $3) <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN $2 ELSE c.spent_tokens + $2 END, budget_window_start = CASE WHEN c.budget_window_start IS NULL OR c.budget_window_start + make_interval(secs => $3) <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE c.budget_window_start END FROM channel_charges g WHERE g.conversation_id = $1 AND c.id = g.channel_id RETURNING c.id, c.spent_tokens, c.budget, c.budget_window_start + make_interval(secs => $3) AS "resets!"
